technical-summary: Added a repeatable read-only CDP/Gateway live monitor for configured gpt-auto DOM evidence across three turns in one provider session, verified the start/active/complete signal conjunction, and made the latest-turn completion selector localization-safe by removing its English aria-label dependency.
user-summary-candidate: gpt-auto completion detection is now backed by repeatable multi-turn live DOM traces and a localization-safe latest-response completion marker.

technical-summary: Made gpt-auto response freshness depend on the latest assistant data-message-id, scoped active DOM evidence to the latest assistant turn, removed broad busy/spinner policy control, added a declarative sustained empty-assistant evidence watchdog, made submission comparison exact, and hardened the live monitor's session matching and cleanup.
user-summary-candidate: gpt-auto now advances from identifiable per-turn DOM evidence, safely detects sustained abandoned empty responses, and avoids false completion from mutations to older responses.

technical-summary: Removed the speculative 120-second empty-response evidence watchdog and its workflow configuration because absence of recognized activity cannot prove provider failure during potentially long tool or reasoning phases.
user-summary-candidate: gpt-auto no longer fails long-paused responses based only on two minutes without recognized activity; only positive terminal evidence or the overall backstop ends the turn.

technical-summary: Made all gateway MCP/task/event consumers resolve the project-selected implementation; added missing standalone resume-by-reference routing and capability; corrected machine-scoped CLI recovery; selected automatic mode for this project; recorded SH24's workflow-driven management and replaceable-backend architecture plus coordination boundaries.
user-summary-candidate: Gateway callers now use the managed shared gateway, persistent gpt-auto chats can be resumed and continued through it after tabs disappear, and operator recovery targets the correct machine service state. A workflow-driven plan now covers safe reconcile/archive/purge and future broker replacement.

technical-summary: Completed host/integration/e2e validation fixes, updated current gpt-auto transport inventory expectations, repaired session and release integration seams, included planning records in the clean Docker image, and corrected dedicated LSP image toolchain PATH/gh/npm prerequisites.
user-summary-candidate: The clean host and Docker suites now pass; remaining isolated LSP and provider lifecycle failures are environment/lifecycle-image issues, not the original hang.

technical-summary: Incorporated a five-stage persistent gpt-auto architecture review into provider-neutral gateway plans: workflow-controlled durable maintenance operations, authoritative operation-store/outbox semantics, advisory notifier, corrected drain admission, thin operator MCP layering, conservative evidence, durable timelines, retention pins/policy, and a separate broker-backed normal work-queue migration. Recorded the live 3900-second false timeout as SH22 evidence.
user-summary-candidate: Redesigned the gateway management roadmap around workflow-driven durable operations, safe provider-neutral reconciliation, clean MCP boundaries, configurable retention, and a future replaceable broker queue.

technical-summary: Finalized SH24 acceptance criteria and revised SH22 so passive observation windows never own execution, 60+ minutes is not treated as definitive failure evidence, and any absolute safety stop is optional machine policy with a distinct classification.
user-summary-candidate: Clarified that long agent responses survive reconnectable observer timeouts and are not failed by a fixed 60-minute boundary.

technical-summary: Corrected gateway-plan terminology: a Provider is an execution backend selected by an Execution Profile for an Agent Definition; maintenance, reconciliation and queue plans now reason about provider-independent agent executions through request/session contracts.
user-summary-candidate: Clarified the architecture so providers back configured agents rather than being described as agents themselves.

technical-summary: Implemented dormant SH24 Slice A/C gateway-maintenance authority alongside the existing gateway: workflow-declared operation states, durable idempotent operation/outbox store, owner-fenced CAS claims and completions, advisory notifier, restart-scanning pump, redacted scope/result/error validation, and per-operation timelines. No implementation selector, service route, queue, request/session mutation, or managed gateway process was changed.
user-summary-candidate: Added the first isolated new-gateway maintenance slice without touching the live gateway or creating a second scheduler.

technical-summary: Made full replacement an explicit gateway acceptance gate: side-by-side code exists only for isolated validation; after durable-history parity, shadow/contract tests and rollback rehearsal, one cutover installs the new sole authority and removes legacy selection, scheduler, status/read paths, shims and obsolete production tests.
user-summary-candidate: Locked in a real gateway replacement rather than a permanent legacy fallback.

technical-summary: Removed migration terminology from the new gateway operation slice: renamed the dormant package/runtime root from maintenance to operations/gateway-operations and updated the plan so neither a legacy gateway nor a maintenance mode is a runtime or public-contract concept.
user-summary-candidate: Removed legacy and maintenance-mode terminology from the new gateway design.

technical-summary: Made provider MCP synchronization prune disabled providers through the sanctioned providers API, corrected the TypeScript LSP availability probe for current npm packages, aligned lifecycle/prompt/provider tests with actual descriptor capabilities, and completed the missing SH24 acceptance criteria.
user-summary-candidate: Fixed the remaining provider/LSP lifecycle test defects and updated stale provider capability tests and planning metadata.

technical-summary: Built the next SH24/SH10 gateway-operations slice: authenticated typed create/get service routes and standalone client methods, redacted public operation projection, conservative read-only reconcile executor, active-operation quiescence accounting, and a state-based drain admission gate that rejects submit/run/resume even through pre-existing leases.
user-summary-candidate: Built a safe gateway operation service and closed the drain bypass without changing the live gateway process.

technical-summary: Moved disabled-provider MCP pruning into the sanctioned providers API, restored coding-LSP boundary compliance, included provider capability descriptors in wheel package data, and wired harness status for direct session MCP smoke composition.
user-summary-candidate: Fixed the final Docker-only architecture, packaging, and MCP smoke issues found by the full run.

technical-summary: Recorded the implemented dormant SH24 foundation, verified scope, test evidence, and explicitly remaining cutover gates in the authoritative plan.
user-summary-candidate: Updated the gateway replacement plan with the code now built and the work still required before cutover.

technical-summary: Activated SH10 alongside SH24 for dependency-first delivery and corrected SH24 terminology after automated wording substitutions, preserving gateway-operation terminology and the full replacement acceptance gate.
user-summary-candidate: Started the prerequisite lifecycle work and corrected the gateway replacement plan terminology.

technical-summary: Updated clean-room packaging validation to match the current bootstrap contract, include provider capability YAML in wheels, and wire the session harness capability in direct smoke composition.
user-summary-candidate: Packaging validation now passes all checks.

technical-summary: Removed elapsed-time, CPU-silence, and fixed-ceiling terminal decisions from gateway worker/session execution; added host-owned durable operation pump and redacted session-lineage retention pin fact.
user-summary-candidate: Gateway execution now waits for real provider/cancellation evidence rather than timing out long-running work, and the standalone host runs durable reconcile operations while protecting session continuation lineage from unsafe retention.

technical-summary: Renamed the durable gateway-operation workflow and added owner-epoch-fenced requeue recovery, allowing a newly claimed standalone service host to safely resume unfinished operations without timeout inference.
user-summary-candidate: Gateway operations now recover safely after service ownership changes and no longer depend on a stale runner claim.

technical-summary: Registered gateway management operation error codes and removed the obsolete timeout-based worker test whose expectations contradicted the no-gateway-kill-timer worker contract; retained crash-tree and parallel-worker coverage.
user-summary-candidate: Removed the stale hanging timeout test and registered the missing gateway error resolutions.

technical-summary: Fixed cross-process managed-service JSON read race, gateway type-safety defects, and the HTTP-handler shutdown deadlock. Performed authorised cutover from an unprovable draining service record to a newly started automatic gateway and verified durable history plus a completed reconcile operation.
user-summary-candidate: Cut over the machine gateway to the tested automatic service, preserving its request history and verifying durable reconcile operations on the new host.

technical-summary: Added management-MCP create/get routes for durable gateway operations, activity-MCP session-resume routing, missing stable error resolutions, and parity/delegation tests. Validated management API against the cut-over host.
user-summary-candidate: Gateway operator work and durable session continuation are now reachable through their intended MCP surfaces, with tested service/client/MCP delegation.

technical-summary: Added standalone positive/negative operation and forced-shutdown E2E coverage; fixed bounded client close after service stop and durable forced-lease revocation so shutdown can retire cleanly.
user-summary-candidate: Expanded gateway tests to cover valid and invalid operator operations plus clean forced cutover shutdown, and fixed the lease cleanup defect they revealed.

technical-summary: Registered the new gateway operation management tools and session resume tool in the component MCP catalog, documented their closed contracts, and added catalog conformance coverage so configuration cannot drift from callable MCP tools.
user-summary-candidate: The new gateway MCP capabilities are now provisioned through configuration and protected against catalog drift by tests.

technical-summary: Begun AS95 parity slice by routing closed provider-neutral session controls through runtime, gateway API, application, embedded/remote clients, service contract, MCP adapter, and MCP catalog. Controls return acknowledgements only and do not mutate lifecycle state.
user-summary-candidate: Gateway sessions now have an initial generic control path through the public gateway and MCP surfaces.

technical-summary: Promoted five valid deferred job test modules into the unit suite and removed the deferred test path; replaced stale provider descriptor and session import skips with assertions/direct imports; enabled the Hindsight prune test; made provider surface lifecycle parameters capability-based; added test isolation for closed singleton event buses so xdist runs complete; removed a host-speed assertion from the parallel worker test; gated consumer-pipeline tests to Docker and updated their current surface-id contract assumptions; registered VAL-AGSV-031; validated 5,338 collected tests with parallel unit and integration suites passing.
user-summary-candidate: Reviewed deferred and skipped tests, promoted valid coverage, removed stale skips, fixed parallel test isolation, and got the host test suites passing.

technical-summary: AS101 durable binding slice: execution records v3 carry nullable admission-time source/capacity fields and bind_and_start_owned_attempt atomically persists validated source/model/capacity generation with the fenced queued-to-running transition before provider invocation; old records migrate without synthetic source identity.
user-summary-candidate: Gateway dispatch now durably records the exact source and model atomically before an agent starts.

technical-summary: Added SH10 Slice D lifecycle proofs: real crashed-client lease expiry and idle exit, reconnect-before-idle cancellation plus draining late-lease refusal, and long-running fake-provider work holding quiescence until terminal. Focused lifecycle, CLI, and architecture suites pass.
user-summary-candidate: Gateway lifecycle now has deterministic proofs for crashed clients, reconnect races, drain fencing, and long-running work.

technical-summary: AS95 generic session controls now persist idempotent control results per session, reject control-id reuse with a different target fingerprint, and replay the original acknowledgement without dispatching again.
user-summary-candidate: Generic session controls now have durable retry safety and conflict detection.

technical-summary: AS91 added a pure provider-neutral proven-owned-turn-dead predicate requiring active-turn ownership and exact foundation process-dead evidence; unknown, external, PID-reuse, silence-only, and deadline cases conservatively produce no action.
user-summary-candidate: Orphan recovery now has a conservative evidence predicate that cannot mistake silence or age for process death.

technical-summary: AS91 now wires the conservative orphan predicate into SessionRuntime reaping. Only exact adopted-child process-dead evidence triggers one orphan timeline/topic event and existing fail-session authority; owning task finally paths release turn resources, with exactly-once guards. Unknown/unobservable evidence leaves work intact.
user-summary-candidate: Proven-dead owned turns now recover exactly once without treating silence, age, or missing handles as death.

technical-summary: SH24 evidence classification now accepts only explicit provider-neutral LIVE or fenced PROVEN_DEAD evidence; mismatched fences, unavailable evidence, silence, and age remain UNKNOWN. Added focused classification tests.
user-summary-candidate: Gateway reconciliation now refuses to treat stale or silent work as dead without matching owner evidence.

technical-summary: Added machine-owned retention policy snapshots, integrity-manifest archive executor, and re-fenced purge executor. Purge is disabled when policy is missing/invalid/changed, blocks pinned or nonterminal requests, verifies archive digest, and rechecks pins immediately before deletion.
user-summary-candidate: Gateway archive and purge now have explicit machine policy and integrity/race safety; no purge occurs without an enabled policy snapshot.

technical-summary: Added provider-neutral AgentWorkQueue protocol and deterministic in-memory conformance fake covering durable identity publish, visibility leases, renewal, ACK/NACK, redelivery, DLQ, drain and health semantics.
user-summary-candidate: The gateway now has a replaceable broker seam with tested claim, redelivery, DLQ and drain behavior, without changing request lifecycle authority.

technical-summary: Connected SH22 activity contract end-to-end for isolated workers: worker host emits request/attempt-fenced heartbeat frames during provider execution, gateway consumes interleaved frames without treating them as terminal, and dispatch forwards only matching activity to durable monotonic lease renewal.
user-summary-candidate: Long-running isolated provider work now renews a gateway-owned activity lease while it runs; stale or malformed activity remains advisory and cannot terminate work.

technical-summary: Purge now enforces machine minimum archive age and verifies both archive tree digest and immutable record snapshot digest before deleting; focused archive/purge tests cover enabled policy timing.
user-summary-candidate: Purge now waits for the configured retention age and refuses altered or corrupted archives.

technical-summary: Made v4 record migration repair partial activity fields without resetting an existing dispatch owner, preserving ownership across schema cutover and restart. Added regression test for a v4 record missing activity fields.
user-summary-candidate: Schema cutover now repairs incomplete v4 records without clobbering active ownership.

technical-summary: Pinned the worker protocol stdout stream before provider stdout redirection so concurrent activity heartbeat frames remain on the authenticated protocol pipe instead of being redirected to operator stderr.
user-summary-candidate: Worker heartbeats remain visible to the gateway even while provider libraries redirect their own stdout.

technical-summary: Retention policy parser now rejects non-finite archive ages, preserving fail-closed machine-policy semantics.
user-summary-candidate: Invalid retention values such as NaN are rejected instead of weakening purge safety.
